attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca), signed node1's ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with principals node1/10.100.61.10/localhost/127.0.0.1, configured sshd via HostCertificate, and reloaded sshd. Verified a client trusting only the CA (@cert-authority entry, no pinned host key, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes) connects successfully with debug logs confirming 'is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate'. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and healthy sshd/cert state, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed (325732f1... -> f40a0274...), and re-verified sshd health, certificate persistence, and CA-trust connectivity post-reboot.
